brief:
Israel threatened to pursue targeted killings and destroyed residential homes in Khan Younis, the Maan news agency reported. The operations unfolded as military campaigns intensified across the southern Gaza Strip region.

The demolitions affected multiple dwellings in the area. Israel's statement on assassination operations represented a declared policy shift toward sustained lethal targeting. No immediate casualty figures were released. The actions underscore escalating pressure on civilian infrastructure and populations in Khan Younis as the conflict continues.
title: Israel threatens continued assassinations, demolishes homes in Khan Younis
